# Source inventory regression: body comment

`compiler_like.py` is a small synthetic Django-like alias-import/class-override
fixture. A comment about SQL "generated by" a base implementation falls within
the first twenty lines. The retired heuristic gate used to leave only a file
node and discard both `as_sql` callables.

The heuristic module is removed entirely: banners, generated-looking names and
long lines no longer suppress parsing. Explicit scan-directory exclusions still
apply and remain in coverage receipts. `python_inventory` verifies DefMarkers
and callable owners; `heuristic_skip_comment_fp` verifies topology for flat and
nested paths; `scan_coverage` covers every release-claimed language and prevents
reuse of old heuristic-skipped inventory. No real Django checkout is needed.
